title: eps, v-prediction and flow: how a model's output is read

questions.q: What do samplers need from every model, whatever its prediction type?
options: An estimate of the clean latent
questions.answer: An estimate of the clean latent
questions.why: calculate_denoised turns each kind of output into that, so samplers do not care which kind the model is.

questions.q: How does a flow model mix noise with a latent?
questions.why: CONST.noise_scaling. Eps and v use latent + σ · noise.

questions.q: A v model read as eps has what error pattern in the lab?
options: Huge at high noise, tiny at low noise
Tiny at high noise, huge at low noise
questions.answer: Huge at high noise, tiny at low noise

questions.q: What does the zsnr switch do on ModelSamplingDiscrete?
options: Rescales the table so the top has almost no signal
Removes the bottom of the table
questions.answer: Rescales the table so the top has almost no signal

questions.q: Why can you not move the number 1.15 from ModelSamplingFlux to ModelSamplingSD3?
options: Flux's number is the log of the same kind of shift
questions.answer: Flux's number is the log of the same kind of shift
questions.why: flux_time_shift uses e^μ, so 1.15 acts like a shift of 3.158.

questions.q: Does changing ModelSamplingDiscrete to v_prediction change how the network behaves?
options: No, it only changes how its output is read
questions.answer: No, it only changes how its output is read
questions.why: It patches a new model_sampling object. The weights are not touched.
